description.text: The Wakuwaku Pokémon Pack (わくわくポケモンパック) was a children's set meal at Domino's Pizza in Japan that came with Pokémon Card Game goods and an original card, in two campaigns of several rounds each: from September 2008 to January 2009 with Munchlax, Snorlax and Snorlax LV.X, and from October 2009 to January 2010 with Slowpoke, Slowbro and Slowking, which carry the Domino's Pizza logo.
